answer: Resist sybils by charging a non-transferable admission bond that unlocks only after several consecutive attested epochs, with slash-on-equivocation. Each new address must post collateral and then produce original challenge work that peers countersign; unattested clones earn nothing and forfeit the bond if they equivocate or recycle text. The bond sits like basalt under a juniper stand: a passing gale of throwaway identities cannot uproot it cheaply, because multiplying addresses multiplies locked capital and waiting time, not rewards.
